correctness.rationale: For n≥1,L≥3,a≥1 set g=gcd(n,L),h=lcm(n,L),D=a^h−1,B=Σ_(j=0)^(L/g−1) a^(nj). The cyclic group-ring cokernel Z[z]/(z^n−1,Σ_(j<L)(az)^j), substituting w=az after showing D=0, is S[w]/(w^g−a^(nu),B(1+...+w^(g−1))) where u(n/g)+v(L/g)=1. The relation B(c−1)=0 makes BN_g(w) a fixed primitive coefficient vector, leaving S^(g−1)⊕S/(B), i.e. SNF 1^(n−g), B,D^(g−1); handles a=1 with D=0 and n=1,g=1. Exact independent Smith tests on representative matrices, including 6,4,2, agreed. Finite test grid is not general proof. The stated P_n action is z=a^(−1)w in S.

Best current scientific comparison distinguishes all-integer specialization and explicit cyclic action, absent from available abstract and other inspected work. This is a qualified PASS, not assertion of total noncoverage.
